columns.description: GRCh38 position on the chromosome sequence named in the table record

columns.name: region

columns.name: codon_number

columns.description: 1, 2 or 3 within the codon
columns.name: codon_position

columns.name: residue_number

columns.description: The GRCh38 base, plus strand
columns.name: genome_base

columns.description: The base on the transcript's strand
columns.name: transcript_base

columns.description: The codon's three bases, read from the assembled coding sequence
columns.name: codon

columns.description: The codon's translation, standard code; `*` for the stop codon
columns.name: amino_acid

columns.description: True where the codon's bases lie in two exons
columns.name: split_codon

columns.description: `not-applicable` where there is no residue (FHIR DataAbsentReason)
columns.name: data_absent_reason

columns.description: The alignment column, 1-based.
columns.name: column

columns.description: The subject residue in this column; empty where the subject has a gap.

columns.description: The subject's amino acid in this column.
columns.name: subject_residue

columns.description: The object residue in this column; empty where the object has a gap.
columns.name: object_position

columns.description: The object's amino acid in this column.
columns.name: object_residue

columns.description: `pair` where both residues are present; `no-correspondence` where one side is a gap.
columns.name: correspondence

columns.description: `none`; `subject-only` (a subject residue against a gap, an insertion in the subject); or `object-only`.
columns.name: indel

columns.description: Columns to the nearest indel column (0 inside one); empty if the alignment has none.
columns.name: distance_to_indel

columns.description: True where alignments of equal score, or the two methods, place this column differently.
columns.name: ambiguous

columns.description: Identical pairs / pairs, over the columns within the window; empty if the window holds no pair.
columns.name: local_identity

columns.description: The number of pairs in the window: local_identity's denominator.
columns.name: local_pairs

columns.description: `standard`, or `lowered` for the reasons given.
